title: restic.forget.v1
description: Retention was applied to a repository: old snapshots were forgotten and, if prune is true, their data removed (restic forget [--prune]).  It runs before a backup, can fail on its own, and does not produce a commit, so it has its own event.  Subject: the stream it belongs to, using the labels of restic.commit.v1 (e.g. 'run').

repository.description: Repository the policy was applied to, with any password removed.

prune.description: Whether unreferenced data was removed too.

keep_policy.description: The retention policy, keyed by restic's --keep-* option without the prefix, e.g. {"last": 2, "daily": 7}.

error.description: What went wrong, in restic's words.  Required when result is fail.
